name: Algebraic_Ising_Obfuscation
description: Replaced the graph-theoretic "vertex cover / independent set" description (dormant frequencies mitigating edges) with an algebraic penalty function on binary multipliers. The total penalty evaluates to exactly -m if and only if the chosen subset forms an independent set. This forces the model to either algebraically prove the equivalence to Independent Set or fall back to a naive combinatorial search which will TLE.
